tool.name: run_summary
tool.description: Run full staged-input descriptive statistics with explicit field, null, non-finite, optional group, and unit context for an exact Data version.

semantics.description: Numeric statistics for the selected field or NPY series across the full staged input, with declared null and non-finite values excluded and counted.
limitations: Full staged input means the complete staged file or array, not a preview sample; it does not prove representativeness of a wider population.
Standard deviation uses population ddof=0 and quartiles use linear interpolation.
An explicit unit is a label only; the operator performs no unit conversion or field-meaning inference.

semantics.description: Auditable full staged input scope, selected field and unit, null and non-finite counts, optional bounded group partitions, conventions, interpretation, and limitations.
limitations: At most 100 distinct groups are returned; higher cardinality fails instead of silently truncating.
Grouped summaries are descriptive partitions, not significance tests or causal comparisons.
The explicit unit is a label only; no unit conversion or field-meaning inference is performed.
The staged artifact can itself be a sample or subset of a wider population.
